_comment: Curated user reviews shown in the Easy OKAPI reviews banner. Visitors cannot write here: they submit through the in-app form, which emails REVIEW_ADMIN_EMAIL. Add a review to `testimonials` only after you have the reviewer's consent to publish their words and attribution. Fields: name (required), quote (required), role, affiliation, rating 1-5, date YYYY-MM-DD. An empty list hides the banner.

_template.name: Reviewer name
_template.quote: What they said about Easy OKAPI, in their own words.
